messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High-severity alert — prod-us-west gpu-pool exhausted, queue growth > 95th percentile, multiple 429/503s observed. Paging oncall.
jessica: I'm on it. seeing big backlog in /v1/generate for model 'redwood-13b'. console shows pending requests climbing from ~200 to 1.2k in 10m.
mike: confirming 429 spikes for customers in us-west, some requests timing out. latency also up, tail p95 -> 1.8s -> 6.4s.
sophia: interestingly HPA metrics (cpu/mem) look fine. HPA custom metric gpu.queue_length is stuck at 0 for last 8m. that smells like metrics pipeline problem, not HPA logic.
omar: +1. metrics-adapter logs show repeated 5xx when talking to Prometheus: "error fetching timeseries: timeout". prometheus scrape backlog after the recent relabel change? I'm pulling logs.
jessica: can we manually scale to buy time? kubectl scale seems quickest.
deploy-bot: executed: kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gpu-worker --replicas=40 (requested by jessica). current ready=12 -> scaling...
mike: started routing non-critical traffic to dedicated-reserved cluster and applying rate-limit to free up capacity. notifying customers for degraded perf via CS.
anna: acknowledging — I'll post a short status note to the affected customers and mark SLAs likely impacted. collecting list of impacted orgs now.
sophia: investigating why gpu.queue_length metric stopped. prometheus target scrape for node-exporter & adapter are healthy but adapter -> metrics-server path shows 502.
nate: I'm going to restart metrics-adapter and metrics-server in kube-system, will do one at a time. will post commands.
jessica: runbook reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-autoscale. handoff to nate for live mitigation after scale completes.
nate: running:
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment metrics-server
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment prometheus-adapter
``` 
I'll watch adapter logs: `kubectl -n monitoring logs -f deploy/prometheus-adapter`
nate: adapter started throwing OOMKilled prior to this spike; looks like recent relabel expansion increased memory usage.
omar: memory graphs show adapter went from 300Mi -> 1.2Gi after relabel rule push 14:03 UTC.
sophia: for immediate fix we can revert the relabel change or trim relabel rules for the adapter. do we have a quick revert patch?
jessica: revert is risky mid-incident. nate, after restart, can you apply a temp relabel prune (drop some high-cardinality targets) to reduce adapter memory? if successful, HPA should see queue_length again.
nate: pruning relabels now, dropping job=external-benchmarks and pod label debug=stacktrace. patch applied via k8s patch to configmap; reloading adapter.
deploy-bot: prometheus-adapter pod rotation completed. new adapters ready.
sophia: adapter logs showing successful query now, gpu.queue_length -> 980. HPA controller sees metric and is triggering scale-up.
jessica: great. how's backlog? any change in pending requests?
mike: pending dropped from 1.2k -> 320 over 6m after manual scale + routing. error rate down to baseline for most customers, a few indy jobs still failing.
anna: updating customers: short note posted, we offered temporary dedicated capacity for impacted enterprise customers. CS to follow up with credits as needed.
omar: root cause hypothesis: a recent relabel expansion pushed prometheus-adapter memory over the edge, causing transient 5xxs and stale custom metrics -> delayed autoscaling and queue growth.
sophia: mitigation summary: manual scale -> routing + rate limits -> restart & prune adapter -> HPA resumed -> queues decreased. need post-incident actions.
jessica: declaring incident Sev1 due to customer impact and page. tagging owners: nate (mitigation & adapter fixes), omar (prom config), sophia (HPA / autoscale runbooks), anna (customer comms).
nate: leaving the live page — handoff to omar for postmortem and durable fix. omar, please run a memory limit bump and create a safer relabel change process (automated mem checks in CI).
omar: will do. opening an issue and will capture commands + logs: https://redwood.internal/issues/INC-2026-gpu-autoscale
jessica: formal handoff: I'm going offline in 15m, omar take lead. if anything regresses ping @jessica and re-page.
nate: noting follow-ups: 1) revert/optimize relabels 2) add adapter mem alert + runbook 3) add a canary for relabel rules 4) autoscaler tolerance for short metric gaps.
anna: CS will send a follow-up status tomorrow and include impacted orgs and mitigation timeline.
incident-bot: Incident updated: Sev1 — GPU autoscale delay (1719812345). Handoff logged. next update in 30m. :rotating_light:
